feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: WenHai-E2E: end-to-end machine learning for global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts
entry.summary: WenHai-E2E produces global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts directly from multisource ocean observations, without initial conditions from a numerical forecast system. The authors state it outperforms a state-of-the-art numerical ocean forecast system (GOFS) in forecast accuracy; the abstract gives… (Discovery - Laoshan Laboratory; Ocean University of China; Shandong University; Qingdao Guoshi Technology Group; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Foundation model and generative AI yield 3CL protease inhibitors confirmed at sub-micromolar IC50
entry.summary: A workflow combining generative models, the MMELON foundation model and filters selected 249 molecules from about 5 million generated. Eighteen were checked with free energy perturbation, and five of those were tested experimentally: all five retained on-target inhibition with IC50 below 1… (Discovery - IBM Research; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Machine-learned potentials resolve a disorder trade-off in lithium cathode transport
entry.summary: Using actively fine-tuned machine-learning interatomic potentials with experimental validation, the authors report that cation disorder improves lithium-path connectivity but broadens site energies, suppressing diffusion in disordered-rocksalt cathodes. They develop an energy-adjusted percolation… (Discovery - Tsinghua University; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Binzhou Institute of Technology; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Human-in-the-loop AI copilot improves topology-optimized structure design
entry.summary: A machine-learning model trained on a synthetic dataset of probable human feedback flags regions of a topology-optimized design that a designer would likely change. The article reports a 39 percent improvement in manufacturability and linear buckling load, adding about 15 seconds of design time… (Discovery - MIT; Georgia Institute of Technology; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Antibody design across observed and forecasted antigenic evolution
entry.summary: Germinal Multi jointly optimizes one antibody paratope against several antigen variants. Designs bound resistance-associated EGFR variants and neutralized historical SARS-CoV-2 variants, including variants withheld from design; redesign of BD55-1205 restored neutralization of a forecast escape… (Discovery - Stanford University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: AI-enhanced electrocardiography for detection and prediction of dilated cardiomyopathy
entry.summary: A deep learning ECG model trained on over 330,000 ECG-echocardiogram pairs detects the echocardiographic dilated cardiomyopathy phenotype (AUROC 0.87-0.97) and predicts incident disease with a C-index of 0.80-0.87, comparable to echocardiography. In two familial cohorts (Antwerp, Maastricht)… (Discovery - Imperial College London; University of Antwerp and Antwerp University Hospital; Maastricht University Medical Center; Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center; UK Biobank cohorts; Zhongshan Hospital of Fudan University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: GPT-6 Astra constructs mutually orthogonal Latin squares that improve lower bounds at 33 orders
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra produced explicit mutually orthogonal Latin-square constructions that improve known lower bounds for N(n) at 33 values of n from 22 through 494. The standout construction gives four MOLS of order 22, completing the last open case needed to show N(n)≥4 for every n>10. The same paper… (Discovery - Christopher D. Rosin (Constructive Codes; independent research project); announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: Deep learning finds an ECG biomarker for sudden cardiac death
entry.summary: A deep learning model trained on about 440,000 Swedish ECGs linked to death certificates isolates a high-risk group (2.2% of the sample) with a 7.0% annual sudden cardiac death rate, versus 4.6% for reduced LVEF; 86.1% of its high-risk patients were not flagged by LVEF. It was externally validated… (Discovery - UC Berkeley; Swedish region health data; US health system; Taiwanese hospital registry; announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: t-SNE-selected LMC radio source receives a spectroscopic AGN classification at z = 2.80
entry.summary: SALT spectroscopy of the previously unclassified source LMC tSNE b8 (R.A. 06:22:41.86, Dec. −68:59:21.9) identified it as an active galactic nucleus at redshift z = 2.80. The source was selected from the blazar-like sequence in a t-SNE map combining VISTA near-infrared and ASKAP radio survey data… (Discovery - Keele University; Southern African Large Telescope collaboration; collaborators; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: GenDIReCT recovers the M87* ring from archival telescope data
entry.summary: GenDIReCT used diffusion-based reconstruction conditioned on calibration-independent closure invariants to analyze EHT observations from 2017, 2018 and 2021. The authors recover ring morphology and estimate a diameter of 42.2 ± 1.5 microarcseconds; geometric modeling gives 42.3 ± 1.1. This is a… (Discovery - CSIRO; The University of Western Australia; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Wearable-based health age models for cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic risk profiling and coaching
entry.summary: A coachable health-age metric built from wearable signals predicted hypertension, cardiovascular disease and type 2 diabetes over eight years in All of Us (n = 22,748), and a world model pre-trained on about 2.28 million Fitbit person-weeks forecast 12-week responses to habit changes. In a blinded… (Discovery - Google Research; Fitbit; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Machine learning reveals incomplete concordance between DNASE1L3 genotype and cfDNA phenotype
entry.summary: Classifiers and UMAP analyzed 129,676 prenatal-test cfDNA samples, with genotype checks in 169 selected samples. The authors report fragmentomic profiles resembling DNASE1L3 R206C homozygotes in some non-homozygotes, while some confirmed homozygotes initially lacked the profile and acquired it in… (Discovery - Amsterdam UMC; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.title: Cross-state representation learning enables prospective discovery of dynamic protein allosteric sites
entry.summary: AllositeUltra, a deep-learning framework for allosteric site detection, reached Top-3 site recovery of 65.2% on apo and 70.6% on substrate-bound structures, versus the best baselines. Prospective application to MAGI2 identified an interdomain allosteric pocket, validated by small-molecule… (Discovery - Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Chinese Academy of Sciences; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.title: Deep learning controls electrical stimulation patterns in human visual cortex
entry.summary: A deep learning framework (a learned inverse network and a gradient-based optimizer) chooses electrical stimulation patterns for a temporarily implanted visual cortex device in a blind participant. The source states both methods outperform conventional calibration, reach targets at lower currents… (Discovery - UC Santa Barbara; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.title: Cockpit public-key helper could follow home-directory symlinks during privileged ownership changes
entry.summary: A local authenticated user who can control a target account home directory can exploit Cockpit’s privileged Add Public Key helper. Symlinks in .ssh or authorized_keys paths could redirect privileged ownership/mode operations to other files, allowing local privilege escalation or unauthorized file… (Vulnerability - AISLE in partnership with Red Hat; announced 2026-11-10)
